closure.statement: The repository owner explicitly directed that every remaining release gate be closed and that the complete version 0.2.0 artifact set be published through trusted publishing.

gates.evidence: Projector compatibility and source-checkout lanes are bound to pyOWLCore 0.2.0 commit 422a63363e0b67857eebfca6dd67595ebaad7a09 and tree 56dc47d73870a786a1248d89bf10a89155fcffff. The owner accepted dependency-order publication with pyowl-core uploaded first.
gates.residual_risk: The projector upload must follow successful pyowl-core 0.2.0 publication and index verification.

gates.evidence: The release workflow binds publication to GitHub OIDC, the pypi environment, and the complete audited release artifact.
gates.residual_risk: Authenticated ownership is ultimately confirmed only when PyPI accepts the first upload.

gates.evidence: The owner waived disposable-private-index staging and authorized direct production publication of the audited universal wheel and sdist.
gates.residual_risk: Same-version native-versus-universal index selection was not staged on a private index.

gates.evidence: The atomic release workflow cannot reach publication unless the universal wheel, sdist, and all five native platform build and installed-smoke matrices succeed.
gates.residual_risk: The tag-scoped hosted run must succeed before the protected publication environment is approved.

gates.evidence: The owner accepted the documented subinterpreter limitation; the pure-Python fallback remains the production-safe default and native probing rejects unsupported runtimes.
gates.residual_risk: Full projection and teardown were not demonstrated across an approved CPython subinterpreter matrix.

gates.evidence: The complete seven-distribution bundle is hash-bound, audited, gated, and attested through GitHub OIDC before the publication job can run.
gates.residual_risk: PyPI trusted-publisher configuration must exactly match the repository, release.yml workflow, and pypi environment.

gates.evidence: The owner accepted the committed NCIT evidence and waived absent GO and licensed-scale corpus runs for 0.2.0.
gates.residual_risk: GO and licensed SNOMED-scale performance evidence remains unavailable.

gates.evidence: The owner waived network-backed advisory and platform binary audits for the compiler-free initial artifact set.
gates.residual_risk: Current advisory-database results and native-wheel binary audit output are not attached.
